items.content_text: Currently, I’ve got four email addresses that I’ve been using for different purposes. My main address that I use, my secondary for work / professional matters, a third for mobile apps to avoid cluttering up my main address, and a fourth for spam. Would it be worthwhile to make a separate address that I use solely for banking purposes or would that be far too many to deal with? I like the current system that I’ve got, but it feels a bit ridiculous to have as many emails as I do right now.
